name: Sandra
source:
An empress who reigns over an empire that launches invasions against neighboring countries.

Arrogant and self-centered. She has a greedy personality, sees others only as tools, and uses her powerful curses to dispose of both her own people and subordinates. She continues to invade other countries to satisfy her own desires and pride.

[From the [url=https://miel-soft.com/saikyoukishi.html]official website[/url]]
